messages:
Anya (PM): Heads-up: Partner RFP asks for per-organization throughput tiers + special add-on that guarantees reserved qps for model A only. They want a deterministic cost for the model A traffic. Need to converge on packaging shape.
Jin (Eng): Is the reserved qps scoped at model-instance level or route? That affects infra changes.
Anya (PM): It's model-scoped (Model A), for their scoring endpoint. They plan to run multiple routes but want the reservation to apply to the Model A serving pool.
Sophia (Revenue): Packaging options: 1) Model-specific reserved blocks (higher price), 2) Cross-model reserved that can be pinned. Model-specific is easier for the customer to reason about.
Nina (Solutions): Customer asks for predictable flat fee. They dislike complex per-token math. We should offer per-month blocks of reserved qps mapped to model usage.
Oliver (Legal): Add addendum language about model downgrades/upgrades; if customer switches models, how do we migrate reserved capacity? Need migration rules.
pricing-bot: Suggestion: Model Reserved Block: $B per 1k qps/month, with 10% soft burst. Overage at 180% unit price.
Jin (Eng): Implement via service mesh tags at model-serving layer. ETA: 4 wks for model-scoped reservation. We'll need changes to autoscaler to respect reservations.
Anya (PM): Launch criteria: 1) per-model metering in Console, 2) mapping UI to attach reserved blocks to model alias, 3) billing sample + reconciliation, 4) 2 pilot customers.
Sophia (Revenue): Contract constraints: minimum 6mo commit for model-specific blocks; offer 15% discount for annual. Also, include SLO credits for downtime > SLA.
Nina (Solutions): For onboarding, we should provide a migration plan in docs: how to reassign reserved blocks when they upgrade models or switch variants.
Oliver (Legal): Note about on-prem/private: require local metering export and signed attestations if customer is air-gapped.
Jin (Eng): Infra note: we can reuse route-level logic but need to ensure scheduler respects model affinity. Also add metric: reserved_qps_model_utilization.
Anya (PM): Decision: pilot with model-scoped reserved blocks (Model A only). Keep cross-model as future.
Sophia (Revenue): I'll draft pricing bands and renewal options.
Nina (Solutions): I'll prepare a customer playbook for migration and mapping.
Oliver (Legal): I'll draft contractual text for migration, termination, and dispute resolution.
Jin (Eng): I'll start a PR for infra changes; request dev time for autoscaler.
Anya (PM): Thanks. Please drop any open questions here in the next 24h.
